facts.text: Admission to LACM's undergraduate music programs requires a minimum high school GPA of 2.5 and an audition evaluating technique and musicality.

sources.title: LACM Undergrad Degrees - LACM
sources.quote: All undergraduate program applicants are required to possess a high school diploma or its equivalent. A minimum cumulative grade point average of 2.5 from the applicant's high school transcript is required for admission.
